items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: Oh man, him and I used to kick it back, man.

ctx.x: Before the Entertainer's, the Entertainer's, I must have started around 25, 1925, 24. And then it lasted until up in the 30s. Yeah, it was up in the 30s because I left here in 31. Went to St. Louis and it was running when I left. So I stayed in 10 to 12 years.
Did the white musicians come in and mix it up then? Yes, indeed man. They always did that, huh? Always did that. Musicians always wanted to play together, didn't they?

It didn't make no difference. What? This boy named Ross Bonet? Mm-hmm. Oh man, him and I used to kick it back, man. What did he play? General Sykes, man. That's one of your greatest Sykes, wrong place.
